claims: Lauren Betts grew up facing bullying regarding her height.
Lauren Betts was the nation's #1 recruit.
Lauren Betts had a challenging freshman year at Stanford with limited playing time and dwindling confidence.
Lauren Betts transferred to UCLA in 2023.
In early 2024, Lauren Betts fought severe depression and anxiety.
Lauren Betts checked into a psychiatric hospital.
Lauren Betts describes checking into a psychiatric hospital as the best decision of her life.
Lauren Betts took a break to focus on her mental health.
Lauren Betts returned to the court.
Lauren Betts became the Big Ten Player of the Year.
Lauren Betts became a first-team All-American.
Lauren Betts led the UCLA Bruins to their first NCAA National Championship in 2026.
Lauren Betts shared her journey on The Players' Tribune.
As of April 2026, Lauren Betts is projected to be a high pick in the WNBA draft.
